about_the_game:
Hexa World 3D is a dynamic 3D puzzle game inspired by the classic Hexa Puzzle, where every match is a unique challenge and a step toward new achievements! Move hexagonal tiles, create powerful combinations, and score points while earning experience for further progress.

What Awaits You:

Procedurally Generated Levels:
Every level is created at random, offering you fresh challenges and unexpected tactical opportunities. No matter the mode, the game always brings something new!

Three Game Modes:

  • Competitive Mode:
    Battle against players from around the world in a 5-minute showdown to score as many points as possible and climb the global rankings.

  • Endless Mode:
    Play without time limits, perfecting your strategy and building combos.

  • Level Mode:
    Conquer procedurally generated levels where every victory earns you experience (XP).

Key Features

Intuitive Progression System:

  • Earn Experience: Every successful combination and level completion adds XP.

  • Level Up: Your level reflects your skills, and as it increases, new opportunities and exclusive content are unlocked, including additional maps, tile skins, and other rewards.

Boosters:
Use built-in boosters to overcome the toughest levels. These aids help you quickly navigate challenging moments and accumulate XP faster, granting temporary advantages in critical situations.

Core Gameplay Mechanics:

  • 3D Hexagonal Grid: Enjoy a three-dimensional perspective and dynamic camera control (top-down view, mouse swipe) for complete immersion.

  • Score Multipliers: The faster and more efficiently you create combos, the higher your score!

  • Dynamic Block Placement: New tiles appear even during animations, making the gameplay smooth and exhilarating.

Online Leaderboards:
Compete with players worldwide in two ranking tables:

  • Permanent Ranking: Reflects your overall progress and mastery.

  • Monthly Competitive Mode: Monthly tournaments for true masters, where every victory is a chance to prove your skill.

Special Achievement for 100,000 Points:
Prove that you are a true master by surpassing this milestone!

Unlockable Maps

Play on your favorite map by unlocking new ones

  • Office (default location) – A modern design with a fresh style.

  • Winter Map – Immerse yourself in a snowy landscape.

  • Game Room – A cozy setting for unique strategies.

  • And more maps to be added in future updates!

Hints and Tutorials:

New players can easily learn the game mechanics with built-in hints.

Localization:

Full support for both Russian and English – choose the language that suits you best!

Immerse yourself in the world of Hexa World 3D—experience dynamic and ever-changing gameplay where every procedurally generated level challenges your logic and reflexes, bringing you closer to new rewards and exclusive content.

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist and join our Discord community to be the first to know about fresh updates and exclusive bonuses for early pioneers!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3-3225 3,3 Hz or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 (ПК); AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: CORE i5-7300U 3,5 Hz or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960, AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9000 MB available space
